rules.//: Mark who currently holds the flag — fires on the base whose node sees the flag within 1m for 1s, sets flag.holding_team. The value only changes when a different team brings the flag home, so the delta handler treats repeated re-applies as no-ops (UI-stable).

Hold-time pulse — fires on the base every tick the flag is within 1m, writing a fresh now_ms into flag.hold_pulse_ms. Because the value changes every tick the delta-side property_changed predicate below fires once per second, so each node increments the holding team's score in lockstep.

Hold-time scoring — runs on every node once the hold_pulse delta lands, so the score[team] counter (≈ seconds of possession) converges through consensus instead of diverging per-tick like a raw tick rule would.

Hard time limit — only the flag's node fires (entity_is: flag) so exactly one GameEnd broadcasts, carrying the winner derived from the flag node's view of scores. winner_team: highest_score picks the strictly-top team and resolves ties to null (rendered as 'draw').
